evals.name: story-provided-freelance-milestone
evals.prompt: I want to post on LinkedIn about how I quit my agency job 14 months ago to freelance, almost gave up after 3 months when I only had 1 client, and just hit $10k/month. Make it engaging. Save the final post as post.md
evals.expected_output: A SLAY-structured post: hook + re-hook, compressed story with the concrete numbers given, single lesson, actionable steps, reader turn at the end, one-sentence-per-line formatting

evals.name: topic-only-no-story
evals.prompt: write me a linkedin post about why cold DMs dont work anymore and what to do instead. Save it as post.md
evals.expected_output: Post built on an observation/pattern opening (no fabricated personal story), still follows hook/re-hook/lead structure, actionable alternatives, ends with reader question

evals.name: rewrite-corporate-draft
evals.prompt: Can you rewrite this LinkedIn post so it actually gets engagement? Here's my draft: 'I am pleased to announce that after extensive research and development, our team has successfully launched our new client onboarding process. This initiative has reduced onboarding time by 40% and significantly improved client satisfaction metrics. I am grateful to my team for their dedication.' Save the rewrite as post.md
evals.expected_output: Corporate speak stripped, rewritten with hook/re-hook using the 40% stat, short lines, lesson + actionable element, ends turning to the reader

evals.name: no-angle-pick-pattern
evals.prompt: I'm a freelance UX designer. I have nothing specific to share but I need to post on LinkedIn today. What should I post? Write it and save as post.md
evals.expected_output: Consults references/template-patterns.md to pick an archetype matching what the user has (likely a teaching or contrarian pattern given no story), asks for real specifics before filling the skeleton, full SLAY treatment applied

evals.name: growth-strategy-question
evals.prompt: I have 300 followers on LinkedIn and post randomly. How do I actually grow like Lara Acosta? Give me a weekly plan.
evals.expected_output: Consults references/growth-strategy.md: recommends comment-first cold start for sub-1K accounts, lays out 4-3-2-1 cadence with posts slotted into pillars and audiences, mentions lead magnet funnel and 3-month commitment floor
